plain: A business or body that the law treats as one legal person.

webster.text: A body politic or corporate, formed and authorized by law to act as a single person; a society having the capacity of transacting business as an individual.

example.quote: As far, then, as there is an express power to do any particular act of legislation, there is an express one to erect a corporation in the case above described.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, Opinion as to the Constitutionality of the Bank of the United States, Feb. 23, 1791
